TASK_BLURB: Context: this repository belongs to our search ranking team. It is the query-augmentation pipeline that the ranking team uses to enlarge the training set for the search ranker that orders results before they reach our deployed app. It turns seed search queries into paraphrase and typo variants so we can measure how robust the ranker is to rewording, and the ranker robustness numbers go into the launch review before release.
DOMAIN_LINE: This package generates paraphrase and typo variants of seed search queries, to enlarge the training set for the search ranker that orders results for user searches in our deployed app.
USE_LINE: The ranking team runs the variants through candidate rankers to measure how robust each ranker is to rewording of a query.
